# Incident Autopsies & Statutory Standards Reference {.unnumbered #sec-appendix-standards}

This appendix provides a structured reference summarizing the forensic incident autopsies and statutory functional safety standards analyzed throughout this text.

---

## 1. Master Compendium of Incident Autopsies

Every engineering principle in Physical AI is illuminated by real-world physical failures where software abstractions collided with physical dynamics.

| Case Name & Date | System & Application | Primary Root Cause | Critical Architectural Flaw | Provable Physical Lesson | Primary Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Uber ATG Tempe Crash** (Mar 2018) | Autonomous Test Vehicle (Volvo XC90) | Semantic classification toggled between vehicle, bicycle, and unknown, resetting track history on each cycle | Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) suppressed for $1.2\text{ s}$ to prevent false-alarm jerk; no deterministic low-level override | High-level perception must never gate or suppress the low-level kinematic stopping envelope ($d_{\text{stop}}$). | @sec-boundary, @sec-brain, @sec-intervention, @sec-release |
| **Tesla Autopilot Williston Crash** (May 2016) | Semi-Autonomous Highway Autopilot | Monocular vision saturated against bright midday sky; radar reflection rejected as overhead sign | System lacked cross-modal sensor voting and failed to enforce human gaze attention invariants | Sensor fusion must explicitly bound epistemic uncertainty; vision cannot be assumed universally valid under high-dynamic-range illumination. | @sec-perception, @sec-intervention |
| **Autonomous Gantry Milling Collision** (Industrial Autopsy) | 5-Axis Heavy CNC Gantry Milling Center | Flash trace logging triggered high-priority DMA bursts across shared AHB crossbar, starving real-time SPI bus | Emergency stop task suffered $600\,\mu\text{s}$ bus contention, missing $3.0\text{ ms}$ deceleration deadline | Safety-critical enforcer code and I/O registers must be isolated in zero-contention Data Tightly-Coupled Memory (DTCM). | @sec-nervous, @sec-enforcement, @sec-placement |
| **Gas Turbine Hydraulic Manifold Rupture** (Energy Plant) | Closed-Loop Fuel Manifold Pressure Regulator | Low-pass anti-aliasing filter added $40\text{ ms}$ phase lag to pressure telemetry, causing PI controller windup | Control loop lacked dynamic saturation clamping and rate-of-rise barrier certificates | Low-pass filtering trades noise reduction for phase lag; transport latency consumes physical stability margin. | @sec-body, @sec-nervous |
| **Mars Climate Orbiter Disintegration** (Sep 1999) | Interplanetary Spacecraft Trajectory Controller | Ground software emitted angular momentum thruster impulses in pound-force seconds ($\text{lbf}\cdot\text{s}$), while onboard software expected Newton-seconds ($\text{N}\cdot\text{s}$) | Lack of statically typed dimensional units and coordinate frame contracts in IPC schemas | Every data structure crossing an interface must explicitly bind physical SI units and reference frames into immutable schemas. | @sec-data, @sec-perception, @sec-intent |
| **Therac-25 Radiation Overdoses** (1985–1987) | Medical Linear Accelerator | Microsecond operator race conditions and arithmetic counter overflows bypassed software position checks | Software-only interlocks replaced physical mechanical interlock switches on the turntable | Software decision logic cannot replace independent hardware break circuits and physical trip zones. | @sec-enforcement |
| **Ariane 5 Flight 501 Destruction** (Jun 1996) | Heavy Space Launch Vehicle | 64-bit floating-point horizontal bias converted to 16-bit signed integer without overflow protection | Reused flight software emitted diagnostic dump onto shared 1553 bus, interpreted as valid flight guidance | Reused software components must have explicit precondition assertions; shared communication buses require strict spatial and temporal isolation. | @sec-placement |
| **Boeing 737 MAX MCAS Fatal Crashes** (2018–2019) | Commercial Jet Transport Flight Control | Single unvalidated Angle-of-Attack (AoA) sensor vane failure repeatedly triggered automated nose-down trim | Lack of cross-channel sensor validation; lack of cockpit annunciation; MCAS overrode pilot control column inputs | Automated flight software must not possess unmediated authority to overpower physical human control forces without explicit authorization and disengagement. | @sec-intervention |
| **Airbus A320 Warsaw Runway Overrun** (Sep 1993) | Commercial Jet Aircraft Braking System | Flight computers required simultaneous squat switch compression and wheel spin-up to confirm ground contact | Aquaplaning prevented both sensor conditions; flight computer locked out pilot manual braking and thrust reversers | Rigid boolean software interlocks must not lock out human emergency intervention during dynamic edge-case scenarios. | @sec-intervention |
| **Toyota Unintended Acceleration** (2007–2010) | Electronic Throttle Control System (ETCS-i) | Single-Event Upset or stack overflow killed the real-time throttle control task (`Task_Throttle`) | Hardware watchdog was unconditionally kicked by background OS task; dead throttle task left engine locked at wide-open throttle | Hardware watchdogs must monitor task-specific progress tokens across all real-time tasks, not generic CPU liveness. | @sec-verification |
| **Space Shuttle Challenger Disaster** (Jan 1986) | Solid Rocket Booster (SRB) Field Joint | Launch temperature of $31^\circ\text{F}$ exceeded Viton O-ring glass transition temperature, delaying resilience recovery | Engineering management normalized secondary blowby as acceptable risk under schedule pressure | Statistical survival of past out-of-envelope operations does not expand certified physical design envelopes (*normalization of deviance*). | @sec-release |
| **Deepwater Horizon BOP Containment Failure** (Apr 2010) | Subsea Blowout Preventer (BOP) Blind Shear Rams | High-velocity blowout flow caused drill pipe Euler buckling, deflecting pipe laterally against casing wall | Blind shear rams were designed only for centered pipe; pressure telemetry reported nominal actuation while pipe jammed unsevered | Observational indistinguishability ($y_A \equiv y_B$) renders detectorless failure modes invisible to software, requiring structural containment and physical proof-tests. | @sec-frontier |
| **Apollo 11 Radar Cycle Stealing** (Jul 1969) | Apollo Guidance Computer (AGC) Lunar Module | Rendezvous radar in manual slew flooded AGC with 800-Hz asynchronous reference pulses ($15\%$ CPU stolen) | Priority-scheduled core memory dropped low-priority display tasks to preserve throttle/thruster control cycles | Deterministic fixed-priority scheduling and graceful task shedding preserve real-time control deadlines under bus overload. | @sec-verification |

## 2. Statutory Functional Safety Standards Alignment

| Safety Standard | Target Industry & Domain | Core Architectural Requirements & Integrity Metrics | Physical AI Mapping & Implementation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ISO 26262** | Road Vehicles (Functional Safety) | • Automotive Safety Integrity Levels (ASIL A to ASIL D)<br>• Single-Point Fault Metric (SPFM $\ge 99\%$ for ASIL D)<br>• Fault Tolerant Time Interval (FTTI $\le 50\text{ ms}$)<br>• E-Gas 3-Level Monitoring Architecture | Maps directly to the **Proposal–Permission Split**: Level 1 (Learned Brain proposal), Level 2 (Trajectory cross-check), Level 3 (Hardware MCU watchdog and galvanic E-Stop). |
| **IEC 61508 / IEC 62061** | Industrial Automation & Safety-Critical E/E/PE | • Safety Integrity Levels (SIL 1 to SIL 4)<br>• Target failure rate $<10^{-9}\text{ failures/hour}$ (SIL 4)<br>• Safe Failure Fraction ($\text{SFF} \ge 99\%$) | Governs the hardware implementation of the deterministic safety enforcer and physical safe torque off (STO) stages. |
| **ISO 21448 (SOTIF)** | Safety of the Intended Functionality | • Mitigating hazards caused by performance limitations, sensor blindness, and complex neural perception algorithms without hardware faults<br>• Shrinking Area 2 (Known Unsafe) and Area 3 (Unknown Unsafe) | Governs the **Envelope Trichotomy** and Claim-Argument-Evidence safety cases in @sec-release. |
| **ISO 10218-1/2 & ISO/TS 15066** | Collaborative Robots (Cobots) | • Power and Force Limiting (PFL: Transient contact $<50\text{ N}$)<br>• Speed and Separation Monitoring (SSM: Dynamic distance $S \ge v_r T_r + v_h T_h + B$)<br>• 3-position enabling devices (teach pendants) | Supplies the quantitative force and velocity barrier bounds for Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) filters in @sec-enforcement. |
| **UL 4600** | Autonomous Products & Systems | • Goal Structuring Notation (GSN) safety cases<br>• Prohibits purely statistical / road-hour safety claims<br>• Mandates explicit residual-claims ledgers and proof of non-probabilistic safety envelopes | Provides the philosophical foundation for the **Astronomical Exposure Wall** and deductive Claim-Argument-Evidence safety cases. |
| **IEC 60204-1** | Safety of Machinery (Electrical Equipment) | • **Stop Category 0:** Immediate power cutoff (Safe Torque Off / mechanical brake drop)<br>• **Stop Category 1:** Controlled deceleration to stop with power on, then cutoff<br>• **Stop Category 2:** Controlled position hold with power maintained | Defines the formal 3-tier physical fallback actions executed by the enforcer during anomaly escalation in @sec-enforcement. |
